newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi term naphtha tender to close Oct 4 - traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi term naphtha tender to close Oct 4 - traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil concern Saudi Aramco has issued a term tender to sell its naphtha cargoes for 1997, traders said on Tuesday.
Potential buyers were asked to submit bids stating volume and initial bidding price by October 4, naphtha traders said. Bids will be valid until October 31.
Saudi Aramco has not specified how many cargoes will be available for the year, they added.
Under current conditions, Ras Tanura A-180 is priced at $3.40 over the Aramco formula, while prices for naphtha cargoes out of Jubail and Rabigh are set at the formula plus $3.00.
Saudi Aramco exports 2.2 to 2.5 million tonnes of Ras Tanura A-180 and about 1.3 million tonnes each of Jubail and Rabigh naphtha on a term basis to Japan and South Korea annually, traders said.
